harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: On node1 (RHEL 7.9), installed yum-plugin-versionlock (via the rhel-7-server-rpms repo, enabled for this purpose) and added a versionlock entry for the installed curl-7.29.0-59.el7 package. Verified with a real newer curl build available in the repo (7.29.0-59.el7_9.2) that an explicit `yum update curl` is blocked ("No packages marked for update"), and that in a mixed update transaction (curl + less + gzip) curl was silently excluded while less and gzip genuinely updated — proving the hold survives a system update. Completed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id and versionlock/curl state, issued `shutdown -r now`, polled until the node came back, confirmed boot_id changed, and re-verified curl version and versionlock protection post-restart (still correctly blocking updates).
actions_performed: Inspected OS (RHEL 7.9) and installed curl version (7.29.0-59.el7) on node1
Attempted yum-plugin-versionlock install; found no enabled repos initially
Temporarily added exclude=curl to /etc/yum.conf as a fallback, later removed once versionlock was available
Discovered node1 is subscription-manager registered with real network access; enabled rhel-7-server-rpms repo
Installed yum-plugin-versionlock package
Added versionlock lock for curl (0:curl-7.29.0-59.el7.*)
Verified a newer curl build (7.29.0-59.el7_9.2) exists in the repo but is excluded from check-update due to versionlock
Ran `yum update -y curl` directly: blocked, 'No packages marked for update'
Ran `yum update -y curl less gzip`: curl silently excluded, less and gzip genuinely upgraded, proving hold survives a broader system update
Cleaned up temporary yum.conf backup file
Captured pre-restart baseline: boot_id, uptime, versionlock listing, curl version
Issued `sudo shutdown -r now` backgrounded so acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until SSH/exec became available again
Confirmed boot_id changed post-restart
Re-verified curl version, versionlock entry, and update-blocking behavior after restart

evidence.requirement: Baseline: curl installed version and hold mechanism state before any restart
evidence.summary: curl-7.29.0-59.el7 installed; versionlock entry '0:curl-7.29.0-59.el7.*' present; boot_id bdbfa15c-cfc4-4b36-8edd-d0a49076e9c5 recorded pre-restart

evidence.requirement: versionlock plugin installed and lock added for curl
evidence.summary: yum-plugin-versionlock installed successfully; 'yum versionlock add curl' confirms lock added and listed

evidence.requirement: Direct proof that a system update leaves curl at its current version
evidence.summary: check-update shows a real newer curl (7.29.0-59.el7_9.2) available but excluded by versionlock; explicit 'yum update -y curl' results in 'No packages marked for update'; a combined update of curl+less+gzip updates less/gzip but leaves curl untouched at 7.29.0-59.el7

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart: acknowledgement returned before disconnect
evidence.summary: Backgrounded 'sudo shutdown -r now' returned pid immediately, before the node dropped

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart: proof of disconnection and reconnection
evidence.summary: First poll timed out (node down mid-reboot); second poll succeeded with a fresh uptime (23:37:13) confirming the node came back up

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart: changed boot identity proving an actual reboot occurred
Node1 restart: post-restart recovery of required state (curl held, versionlock intact)
evidence.summary: Post-restart: curl still 7.29.0-59.el7, versionlock entry intact, and a real update attempt against curl is still blocked ('No packages marked for update')
